title: Shapes for Piano 1
summary: GeoMusica’s first album brings together nine pieces for microtonal piano. The subdivisions of polygons and stellated shapes determine the pitches. In the opening track, subdivisions of a triangle preserve the melodic contour as the scale changes.

descriptions.content:
O primeiro álbum da GeoMusica reúne nove peças para piano microtonal. As subdivisões de polígonos e formas estreladas determinam as frequências das notas. Na primeira faixa, as subdivisões de um triângulo preservam o contorno melódico à medida que a escala se transforma.

Capa: pormenor de Melencolia I (1514), de Albrecht Dürer.

GeoMusica’s first album brings together nine pieces for microtonal piano. The subdivisions of polygons and stellated shapes determine the pitches. In the opening track, subdivisions of a triangle preserve the melodic contour as the scale changes.

Cover: detail from Melencolia I (1514) by Albrecht Dürer.
